issues.what: Linear Pottery culture -5300 keyframe and ledger/1 use the whole of Niedersachsen (218 cells, about 45 of them north of 53.3N on the North Sea coast and Elbe-Weser Geest); the page says the LBK 'did not reach the northern coastal regions of Germany, Poland, or Denmark' (Mesolithic cultures held the coast). The -5200 keyframe and later ones use Niedersachsen whole too, so the overdraw runs through the whole life of the state.

Size-rule conflict linear-pottery-culture vs vinca-culture, 13 cells at Csongrad in -5300; Vinca won. Vinca's page puts it in 'parts of Southernmost Hungary'; the Alfold LBK group is north of the Koros. Tiny, a border cell fight; no source separates them better.

Keyframe snap linear-pottery-culture_-5300: +129 cells in Kosicky, Borsod-Abauj-Zemplen and Szabolcs-Szatmar-Bereg (north-east Alfold) that the ledger (ledger/2, Alfold gain from starcevo-koros-cris-culture, which held only 77 cells there) did not give. The page says the classical Alfold culture appeared 'at around 5330 BC' north of the Koros, so the keyframe is right and the ledger event only lacks the nobody-held part; under the 200-cell threshold.

Beixin culture founded -5300 with 579 cells (423 in Shandong): matches 'central and southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu'; no relations, contests or skipped events in the window; no hierarchy.csv or colonies.csv rows for any state alive here.

patch_check: no patch written; nothing to check

dossier_requests.what: Cut the North Sea coast and Elbe-Weser Geest from Niedersachsen (about 45 of its 218 cells, north of about 53.3N) in the LBK keyframes (-5300, -5200 and the later ones that name Niedersachsen) and in ledger/1 (-5300 gain), for example by replacing the whole-Niedersachsen entry with Niedersachsen minus its coastal strip.
dossier_requests.why: The LBK page says the culture 'did not reach the northern coastal regions of Germany, Poland, or Denmark'; the compiled shape reaches the coast. A patch in this window alone would give a 45-cell jump back at -5200 when the -5200 keyframe (which also names Niedersachsen whole) snaps the state, so the fix belongs in the dossier, across all keyframes.

problems: Cliopatria has no shapes in -5300..-5201, so the --compare-cliopatria panels are empty and only the dossiers' page-based extents could be judged.
The three neighbour-colour check lists no pairs; separately, linear-pottery-culture, beixin-culture and hoabinhian share one ochre in colours.json (not neighbours here, so not a clash).
